new_entities.name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server

quotes.text: Managed means patched, it doesn't mean optimized. Consider managed like hotel housekeeping. They'll make the bed and replace towels, but if you leave the faucet running, that water charge is yours.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects the common misconception that a managed database is automatically cost-optimized.

quotes.text: Compute you can stop. Storage never sleeps. Every megabyte provision has a permanent price tag, whether a single query runs or not.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains concisely why storage is the hidden cost driver even when compute is paused.

quotes.text: Resilience is not redundancy. Real resilience means measured recovery, not blind duplication. Protect critical transactions, ignore vanity staging, and keep paranoia proportional to revenue risk.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a clear rule for when high availability is worth paying for.

quotes.text: Most teams never attempt a restore until it's too late. Backups you've never tested are Schrodinger's safety net, both valid and worthless.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable reminder that untested backups provide no real assurance.

quotes.text: Defaults are designed to prevent support tickets, not optimize invoices. Profiling, alerting and observable metrics replace guesswork far better than recommended modes ever will.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Challenges default bias in cloud deployments and recommends measurement instead.

takeaways: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server bills like a dedicated VM, so compute must be right-sized, scheduled and kept off Burstable tiers for steady production loads.
Storage auto-grow never shrinks and Premium SSD v2 bills capacity, IOPS and throughput separately, so cap growth and size disks to observed need.
Use high availability only for mission-critical workloads, offload reads to asynchronous read replicas, control maintenance windows and add tested logical backups.
hook: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server bills can climb even without more traffic. This episode is for database admins and cloud architects who trusted the default settings. It shows where compute, storage, high availability, replicas, maintenance and backups quietly add cost, and how to cut them without losing resilience.
